title: Add individual hole score editing with automatic recalculation

requirements.summary: Modify the GolferScoreEntryList component to allow editing of individual hole scores after initial entry
acceptanceCriteria: All hole score input fields remain editable throughout the score entry process
Users can modify any previously entered hole score at any time before final submission
Modified scores update the front nine, back nine, and gross total calculations immediately

file_operations.description: Remove any logic that disables hole score input fields after initial entry. Ensure all hole score inputs remain editable throughout the score entry process. Maintain existing validation rules (numeric input, 1-15 range) and automatic calculation of front nine, back nine, and gross totals whenever any hole score changes.

requirements.summary: Implement automatic recalculation of front nine, back nine, and gross totals whenever any individual hole score is changed
acceptanceCriteria: Score subtotals (front nine, back nine, gross total) update in real-time as hole scores are edited
Recalculation occurs without requiring page refresh or navigation
All validation rules continue to apply to edited scores (numeric, 1-15 range)

file_operations.description: Ensure the existing calculation logic for front nine, back nine, and gross totals runs reactively whenever any hole score value changes. Verify that subtotals update immediately in real-time without requiring page refresh. Maintain all existing validation rules including numeric input and 1-15 range constraints.

requirements.summary: Ensure the LeaderboardView recalculates Callaway results automatically when returning from score entry with modified scores
acceptanceCriteria: Leaderboard standings reflect updated scores immediately upon navigation from score entry
Net scores, deductions, and adjustments are recalculated based on edited hole scores
Rankings update correctly with tie-breaking logic applied to modified results

file_operations.description: Verify that the Callaway calculation logic runs on the latest golfer data whenever the LeaderboardView component mounts or when golfer data changes. Ensure net scores, deductions, adjustments, and rankings update correctly based on any modified hole scores. Maintain existing tie-breaking logic for ranking calculations.

Review the state management for golfer data to ensure that when users navigate from score entry back to the leaderboard, the latest modified scores are properly passed to LeaderboardView for recalculation. Verify that the three-step workflow correctly propagates updated scores.
